Formatting a document and a range of it: the project's settings, not the
editor's (the script's requests ask for tabs of eight), as one edit for
each stretch of whitespace that changes.

-- lib/dgdtools.yml --
root: .
format:
  indent_width: 2
-- lib/obj/a.c --
int
f(int a)
{
  if (a > 1) {
return a+1;
        }
  return   0;
}

int g(){return 1;}
-- lib/obj/c.c --
void
f()
{
  x = 1;
/* Comments above a range */
    /* that are not in it. */
      y=2;
}
-- lib/obj/bad.c --
int f() { return '; }
-- script --
initialize lib
open lib/obj/a.c

# Lines 5 and 6 only (a range that ends at the start of line 7).
format lib/obj/a.c 4:0-6:0
# The whole document.
format lib/obj/a.c
# Formatted, there is nothing to do.
format lib/obj/a.c
format lib/obj/a.c 0:0-4:0

# A range whose first line has comments above it, as an editor sends
# the selection of one line: its edits are on that line.
open lib/obj/c.c
format lib/obj/c.c 6:0-6:10

# A text the formatter refuses gets no edits, and a line in the log.
open lib/obj/bad.c
diagnostics lib/obj/bad.c
format lib/obj/bad.c
received window/logMessage
# A document that is not open, and one that is no file.
request textDocument/formatting {"textDocument":{"uri":"file:///nowhere.c"},"options":{}}
shutdown
exit
